facts.fact: UNESCO and IIPE, funding and supporting the education ministry's planning and statistics unit (CPS-SE), held a workshop at Fana on 11-15 March 2026 to analyse national SIGE school-health data for 2023-2024 and 2024-2025, after building the unit's capacity since 2021 to add routine school-health indicators to the SIGE; no published product is stated.
